answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing verifiable computational puzzles embedded within a cryptographic ledger, much like carving a structural ridge into a digital foundation. Every agent must stake tokens to traverse each computational terrace of verification, ensuring that generating fake identities incurs a direct financial penalty. This protocol binds economic output to a scarce resource, making the cost of mass identity fabrication as heavy as moving a physical marble uphill for every artificial node created.
